title: Pennsylvania: The Little Red Schoolhouse
coreRelationships: The large figures in the foreground lead the eye towards the red schoolhouse in the mid-ground.
The winding path creates a sense of depth and guides the viewer's gaze through the scene.
The scattered birds in the sky balance the composition and add a sense of movement.
The folk art birds at the bottom frame the text and ground the entire illustration.
The red schoolhouse acts as a focal point, drawing attention with its contrasting color.
reuseFormula: Recreate a vintage-style travel poster featuring plain-dressed individuals (man and woman in foreground, smaller groups in background) walking on a winding path towards a red schoolhouse with a steeple. The sky should be light with scattered, stylized birds. The bottom border must include decorative folk art elements, framing the bold text 'PENNSYLVANIA' and 'THE LITTLE RED SCHOOLHOUSE'. Use a limited palette of desaturated colors with strong red and teal accents, and maintain a flat, graphic illustration style with clear outlines.
